lectures.title: Set Method - Circular Doubly Linked List

cues.en: Now, the next method that we are going to look at is going to be the set method.
Now set method takes two parameters index and value.
So based on this index it's finding the node and changing that node's value to the value that is passed
as a parameter.
So in this case let's say we are calling set value method with the index of one.
And to change it to 50.
Now first it will check that if the node is located in the first half or not.
So we know that the node with the index of one is located in the first half.
It's going to start from the head and continue until it finds the node, and change that node's value
to the value that we have passed over here.
In this case, it is 50.
Now, if you want to call the set value method with the index of two, in this case, we see that the
node with the index of two is located in the second half, and it's going to start from tail and find
out the node and change its value.
So basically the logic will be the same as the one that we have in case of get method.
So here the only difference is we are updating the value of the node that we have found.
But in case of the get method, we are returning the node that is located with the given index.
Now that's why when we are implementing the set method we are going to use the get method.
So here we are going to declare the set value method inside the socket double linked list class.
Then we are going to get the node with the index that is passed over here by using the get method.
So I'm going to save this node inside the temp variable.
So in this case for example we are looking for the node with the index of two.
Then we are going to check that if temp variable is not null because in some cases get method returns
the null.
For example for negative index or for the index which is greater than the length of the circular double
linked list.
So we have to check this case now after checking this, if it is not null, we are going to update the
temp node's value to the value that we are getting as a parameter, and we are going to return true.
So in this case, we are updating the node with the index of two.
For example we have change it to 50.
Then if this is not the case, we are going to return false.
So as you can see by using the Get method, this set method becomes very simple.
So what I'm going to do I'll just go ahead and implement the set value method inside the circle double
linked list class, and then check how this is going to work.
So here after get we can just set method.
So you can put set value or set.
So the reason why I'm putting set value because we are updating the value of the node not itself.
So that's why it's going to be like this.
So it's going to take two parameter index and value.
Then I'm going to create a variable temp.
And in this variable we will save the node that we are getting from the get method.
Then I'm going to check if temp.
Then in this case we are just accessing the temp node value is equal to value that we are getting from
the console, and we are going to return true.
Otherwise, if this is not the case, I'm going to return false.
Now if I just go ahead and call set value method for index of one and change it to 50 and run our code.
So I'm just going to clear the console and run our code.
You see that it's going to return true.
Then I'm just going to go ahead and write over here new circle double linked list to see the values.
You will see that the first node is with the value of 30.
And the second node is with the value of 50 over here.
So as you can see it's updated like this.
Now if I just go ahead and put minus one, then after doing so we can just go ahead and print out the
to the console by using toString method.
So I'll just put it like this.
So let's just clear the console and run this.
You will see that when we put minus one nothing is changed.
Now if I put over here for example zero and rerun our code you will see that first node is changed over
here.
Now that's how the set value method works.
Now here again the time complexity is going to be zero.
Because in this line of code we are using the get method which takes the on time complexity.
That's why the whole time complexity for set value method is going to be on.
Now the space complexity is also O one, because here again an extra memory is not required to perform
this operation.
That's why the space complexity is O one.
